description.en: The ID of the prefix list.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

descriptions.zh: 前缀列表与其他资源存在关联时，不能直接删除，需要先在其他资源中解除对该前缀列表的关联，再执行删除操作。您可以调用[DescribePrefixListAssociations](~~204724~~)查询指定前缀列表的已关联资源。
descriptions.en: If a prefix list is associated with other resources, you cannot directly delete it. Dissociate the prefix list from the other resources first, and then delete it. You can call [DescribePrefixListAssociations](~~204724~~) to query the resources associated with a specified prefix list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs delete-prefix-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --prefix-list-id pl-x1j1k5ykzqlixdcy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
